notes: Seed catalog for the wyrd-7tz meaning_synset table.
Each entry is one canonical_label string under 'category/subcategory'
convention. 'hypernym' is optional and points at another canonical_label
in this file (resolved at seed time to a foreign-key id).
Coverage focus: the high-frequency place-name semantic classes that
appear in the bundled English/Scottish/Welsh/Irish/Breton corpora.
Tree species and creature names are split into their own synsets
rather than collapsed under generic 'tree'/'creature' categories so
that meaning-preserving substitutions stay specific (oak→oak, not
oak→ash). Phase 2 of wyrd-7tz will populate etymon memberships via
an LLM-assisted classification pass against the lexicon DB.

synsets.label: water
synsets.notes: All water — body, flowing, weather. Hypernym for the water/* tree.

synsets.label: water/flowing
synsets.notes: Streams, rivers, brooks. OE wæter, strēam, ēa, burna; ON bekkr; Welsh nant.

synsets.label: water/body
synsets.notes: Lakes, meres, pools, seas. OE mere, sǣ, pōl; ON sær.

synsets.label: water/crossable
synsets.notes: Fords, bridges, crossings. OE ford, brycg; ON bryggja.

synsets.label: water/spring
synsets.notes: Springs, wells. OE wella, spryng.

synsets.label: water/marsh
synsets.notes: Marsh, fen, mire, wetland. OE mersc, fenn; ON kjarr.

synsets.label: hill
synsets.notes: All hills — generic + subtypes. Hypernym for hill/*.

synsets.label: hill/rounded
synsets.notes: Rounded hills, knolls, hillocks. OE hyll, hōh, dūn.

synsets.label: hill/steep
synsets.notes: Steep slopes, scarps. OE clif, hangra.

synsets.label: hill/ridge
synsets.notes: Ridges, escarpments. OE hrycg; ON hryggr; Welsh trum.

synsets.label: hill/pass
synsets.notes: Passes, gaps, cols. OE skarð; Welsh bwlch.

synsets.label: hill/peak
synsets.notes: Peaks, summits. OE pīc; Welsh penn.

synsets.label: hill/valley
synsets.notes: Valleys, dales, denes. OE denu, dæl; ON dalr.

synsets.label: enclosure
synsets.notes: Bounded settlement / agricultural unit. Hypernym for enclosure/*.

synsets.label: enclosure/farmstead

synsets.label: enclosure/fortified
synsets.notes: Forts, burhs, castles. OE burh, ceaster; Welsh caer.

synsets.label: enclosure/manor
synsets.notes: Manors, halls, estates. OE worth, hām; ON garðr.

synsets.label: enclosure/yard
synsets.notes: Yards, garths, paddocks. OE geard; ON garðr.

synsets.label: dwelling
synsets.notes: Habitations. Hypernym for dwelling/*.

synsets.label: dwelling/cottage
synsets.notes: Small dwellings. OE cot.

synsets.label: dwelling/hall
synsets.notes: Halls, large dwellings. OE heall, sele.

synsets.label: dwelling/temple

synsets.label: landscape/wood
synsets.notes: Woods, forests. OE wudu, holt; Welsh coed.

synsets.label: landscape/clearing
synsets.notes: Clearings, glades. OE lēah.

synsets.label: landscape/grove
synsets.notes: Groves, copses. OE bearu, holt.

synsets.label: landscape/heath
synsets.notes: Heaths, moorland. OE hǣth, mōr.

synsets.label: landscape/island
synsets.notes: Islands, eyots. OE īeg, ēg; ON ey.

synsets.label: landscape/promontory
synsets.notes: Promontories, headlands, points. OE næss; ON nes.

synsets.label: direction

synsets.label: direction/south

synsets.notes: OE ēast; ON austr.

synsets.label: direction/west

synsets.label: colour

synsets.notes: Thorn. OE þorn.

synsets.label: tree/yew

synsets.label: animal/wild
synsets.notes: Wild animals — wolf, deer, bear, boar.

synsets.label: infrastructure/boundary

synsets.label: infrastructure/stone

synsets.label: religion/saint

synsets.label: religion/sacred
synsets.notes: Sacred sites, temples, holy places. OE hālig, hearg, wīh.
